from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenue(BaseModel):
    """One company's revenue figures for a period, as reported in one financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    current_period_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Revenue amount for the current period")
    current_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    current_period_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Net sales', 'Total revenue')")
    current_period: str | None = Field(description="The current period description (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    previous_period_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Revenue amount for the comparable previous period")
    previous_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    previous_period: str | None = Field(description="The previous period description")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the revenue figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_revenues: list[CompanyRevenue]
